test_jittable_jit: test that a Jittable subclass can be passed through jax.jit and access its data tree
test_jittable_vmap: test that a Jittable subclass works with jax.vmap across different in_axes dimensions
test_jittable_traceable_grad: test that modifications to a Jittable object are correctly traced through jax.grad
test_jittable_multiple_instances: test passing different Jittable instances to the same compiled jax.jit function
test_jittable_tracer_leak: test that modifying Jittable object data after jit compilation does not leak tracers
